fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A claw pulls the target apart at the seams, dealing 20 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Spun Snare
fusions.desc: Binds the first enemy it meets, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bandaged Ranks
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Wrapped Beneath
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 5% physical resistance.
